"In The Money" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, most is in wins under $2,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Today's free summary of "In The Money" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
